title: Adventurous Aromatic Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: A winey and chewy Turkish dish featuring lamb, iceberg lettuce, and a macrobiotic-friendly approach, all steamed to perfection in a bamboo steamer. This recipe brings a unique blend of flavors and textures to the table.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together red wine, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Prepare the bamboo steamer by filling the bottom with 2 inches of water and bringing it to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and place the lamb cubes in the steamer basket, reserving the marinade.
Steam the lamb for 10 minutes, then add the separated iceberg lettuce leaves on top and continue steaming for another 5 minutes.
While the lamb and lettuce are steaming, mix the reserved marinade with lemon juice in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the sauce for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened.
Remove the lamb and lettuce from the steamer and serve hot, drizzled with the sauce and garnished with additional lettuce leaves if desired.
